documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported a revenue of ₹110.7 crores and an EBITDA of ₹22.6 crores for FY26, representing significant year-on-year growth. The company operates an ISO-certified manufacturing facility in Ahmedabad with an installed capacity of 22,000 MTPA, achieving a capacity utilization of 52.7% in FY26. Neochem is actively diversifying its product applications into home and personal care to reduce single-segment concentration risk and is expanding its geographical presence across international markets. Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported a 32% year-on-year growth in revenue from operations to INR 110.7 crores for FY26, with EBITDA margins expanding to 20.4%. The company successfully listed on the NSE Emerge platform during the year and substantially reduced its long-term borrowings to INR 0.7 crores.

guidance.claim: The company aims to bring trade receivables to around 120 days by H1 FY27 or latest by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: Having said that, we understand that it is again going a little out of line as compared to our previous numbers, and we aim to bring it to around 120 days, maybe by H1 FY27 or latest by the end of FY27.

guidance.claim: The company targets 30% to 35% of its revenue to come from exports in the next three years.
guidance.quote: But it's an entire cycle, sir, that it's not only one country. Lot of things are interconnected. So we saw some hit there, but broadly we see that in next three years Neochem's target is that we should have 30-35% revenue coming from exports.

guidance.claim: The company expects bio-based esters and silicones to contribute around 55% to 60% of total revenue over the next two years.
guidance.quote: We would like these two categories to contribute around 55% to 60% of our total revenue over the next two years.

guidance.claim: The company expects textile contribution to come down to below 50% of total revenue over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Going forward, over the next three years, while we will continue to grow in textiles, the textile contribution should come down to below 50% of the total revenue.

guidance.claim: The company targets R&D spend to be around 3% of revenue for this year.
guidance.quote: So these are the three key parameters on which we are carrying out R&D, but broadly around 3% would be the target number for this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong local demand and supportive policies are encouraging Indian firms to increase investments in R&D and production capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong local demand and supportive policy are driving Indian firms to invest more in R&D and production capacity

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in FY26 was driven by broad-based demand across the product portfolio and end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: As briefly mentioned, revenue from operations for FY26 stood at INR110.7 crores, representing a growth of 32% year-on-year, driven by broad-based demand across our product portfolio and end-user industries.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees that customers are currently in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks as raw material prices cool off.
demand_outlook.quote: April was also fantastic, but now that the prices are cooling off a little bit, we see that customers are in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks, and broadly, they will start procurement again for their next production cycle.

capex_expansion.claim: The company does not require major manufacturing capex in the near term due to available capacity headroom.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally important, with nearly 47% capacity headroom still available within our existing facility, we possess significant embedded growth potential without requiring major manufacturing capex in the near term.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for future expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, our land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for the next phase of expansion whenever business requirements warrant additional capacity creation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: On your second question regarding capex, we will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's cash flow from investing activities was negative Rs 6.5 crores in FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved to 20.4% in FY26, representing an expansion of over 300 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 53% year-on-year to INR22.6 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 20.4%, an expansion of over 300 plus basis points over the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improvement was driven by favorable product mix, higher capacity utilization, operating leverage, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: The improvement in profitability was driven by a combination of favorable product mix, higher capacity utilization, operating leverage benefits, and continued cost discipline across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs remained broadly aligned with revenue growth, reflecting a stable input cost environment.
margins_costs.quote: Raw material cost remained broadly aligned with the revenue growth, reflecting a relatively stable input cost environment during the year.

margins_costs.claim: The company believes margins of around 35% gross margin, 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and 10% to 12% PAT margin are sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: So yes. As I have said in our pre-IPO meetings, and as I am reiterating today, we believe these margins are sustainable for this kind of product mix and the industries that we currently cater to, around 35% gross margin, around 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and around 10% to 12% PAT margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's integrated manufacturing facility at Moraiya has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our integrated manufacturing facility located at Moraiya, Ahmedabad, has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Over the last few years, capacity utilization has steadily improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity utilization reached 52.7% in FY26 with actual production of 11,589 MT.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term borrowings decreased significantly to ₹0.7 crores in FY26.
Net cash from operating activities was negative ₹19.1 crores in FY26.
Net cash from financing activities was ₹25.7 crores in FY26.
Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores in FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to just INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores FY25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized a portion of its IPO proceeds towards the repayment of legacy debt.
capital_allocation.quote: This reflects our disciplined approach to capital allocation and our decision to utilize a portion of IPO proceeds towards repayment of legacy debt.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt-to-equity ratio improved from 1.8 in FY25 to 0.2 in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-to-equity ratio has improved significantly from 1.8 in FY25 to 0.2 in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term borrowings decreased to Rs 0.7 crores in FY26 from Rs 14.3 crores in FY25.
Share capital increased to Rs 17.1 crores in FY26 from Rs 6.7 crores in FY25.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's business exhibits seasonality, with approximately 55% of annual revenue generated during the second half of the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is worth noting that our business exhibits a degree of seasonality with approximately 55% of annual revenue typically generated during the second half of the year, and nearly 30% plus during the fourth quarter alone.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia crisis caused an immediate price rise in raw materials, with around 30% of raw materials directly related to crude.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the approach that we had, because we had seen the FY21 supply chain crisis, we had already experienced the peak at which the prices started increasing, and around 30% of the raw materials that we use are directly related to crude.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has one trade receivable item over two years old that is currently pending judgment in the NCLT.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is only one line item which is more than two or two-and-a-half years old, wherein the trade receivable is still on the books because the matter has gone to the NCLT, where the judgment is pending.
